title: OPFL: Optimistic Verification of Federated Learning via Empirical Boundary
abstract: arXiv:2609.37011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated learning enables multiple clients to collaboratively train models without sharing their private data. However, the lack of visibility into local training makes it difficult to verify whether clients follow the prescribed training procedure or submit malicious updates, such as model poisoning. A natural approach is to replay client training for verification. However, privacy-preserving replay produces numerical results that cannot be directly matched with local client execution because the two run in different environments. We present OPFL, an optimistic verification framework for privacy-preserving federated learning. To protect data privacy, OPFL performs replay inside secure multi-party computation (MPC). Although gradients computed on MPC and local GPUs are not bitwise identical, we observe that their absolute differences are stable and bounded. translated_title: OPFL：基于经验边界的联邦学习乐观验证
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使多个客户端能够在不共享各自私有数据的情况下协同训练模型。然而，由于无法看到本地训练过程，很难验证客户端是否遵循规定的训练流程，或者是否提交了恶意更新（如模型投毒）。一种自然的方法是重放客户端训练来进行验证。然而，隐私保护的重放所产生的数值结果无法与客户端本地执行的结果直接匹配，因为两者运行在不同的环境中。我们提出了OPFL，一个面向隐私保护联邦学习的乐观验证框架。为了保护数据隐私，OPFL在安全多方计算（MPC）内部执行重放。尽管在MPC上与在本地GPU上计算得到的梯度并非逐位相同，我们观察到两者的绝对差异是稳定且有界的。因此，OPFL在离线阶段校准出一个经验边界，并利用它来区分诚实客户端与恶意更新。
tldr: 提出OPFL框架，在安全多方计算中重放客户端训练，并利用MPC与本地GPU梯度差异稳定且有界的特点离线校准经验边界，从而在保护隐私的前提下乐观地验证联邦学习客户端是否诚实训练。
en_tdlr: OPFL is an optimistic verification framework for privacy-preserving federated learning that replays client training inside secure multi-party computation and uses an offline-calibrated empirical boundary—based on the stable, bounded differences between MPC-computed and locally computed gradients—to distinguish honest clients from malicious updates.
